hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; in=$(cat); echo "$in" | grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' && exit 0; [ -f scripts/verify-ui.sh ] || exit 0; out=$(bash scripts/verify-ui.sh --skip-tsc 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
